projectDescription: A mobile-first transit web app for City Metro that lets riders explore the network on an interactive map, plan multi-leg trips with live vehicle arrivals, and save journeys to their account.
keyFeatures: Interactive canvas-based transit map with pan, pinch-zoom, and tap-to-select stations
Multi-mode trip planner (fastest, fewest transfers, least walking) with step-by-step navigation
Real-time vehicle tracking with live arrival countdowns for bus and rail
Per-line screen showing stop list, live vehicle positions, service alerts, and walking connections
Individual vehicle sheet with stops-away count, next stop, and accessibility info
Station popup with next arrivals per direction and full stop lists for each line
OAuth-based sign-in via Authentik for saving and syncing journeys across devices
Mobile-first responsive UI with swipeable panels, bottom sheets, and a hamburger nav drawer
Cloudflare Workers + static assets deployment via wrangler
publicApiSurface: GET /api/network — full network data (lines, stations, segments, streets, walk_links, settings)
GET /api/live — live vehicle positions for all lines
GET /api/plan?from_station=<id>&to_station=<id> — multi-mode trip planning response
GET /api/advisories?line_id=<id> — service alerts for a specific line
GET /api/journeys — saved journeys for the authenticated user
POST /api/journeys — save a new journey
DELETE /api/journeys/:id — delete a saved journey
GET /api/auth/login?site=<origin>&return=<path> — initiate OAuth login flow
Auth.token() — retrieve stored Bearer token from localStorage
Auth.user() — retrieve stored user object from localStorage
Auth.set(token, user) — persist auth credentials
Auth.clear() — remove auth credentials
Auth.login(returnTo) — redirect to Authentik OAuth flow
api(path, opts) — authenticated fetch wrapper returning parsed JSON
loadNetwork(force?) — fetch and index the full network, cached as a singleton promise
refreshVehicles(net) — fetch latest live vehicle positions and update net.vehicles
MapView — canvas-based map renderer with fitAll/fitLine/fitRoute/focusStation methods
renderLineScreen(root, opts) — mount the per-line stop/vehicle/alert panel
vehicleSheet({net, v, stationId, mode}) — render the single-vehicle detail card HTML
vehicleRows(net, lineId, stationId?) — render the tappable list of vehicles on a line
nearbyServices(pin, net, maxStations?) — nearest services within MAX_WALK_MIN walking time
departures(stationId, lineId, net) — outbound/inbound ETAs for a station on a line
stationBoard(stationId, net) — all lines and arrival directions for a station
lineStops(lineId, net) — ordered stop list for a line
etaMinutes(v, targetId, net) — minutes until a vehicle reaches a target station
trackVehicle(v, targetId, net) — stops and seconds from a vehicle to a target station
MODES — routing preference options: fastest, fewest_transfers, fewest_walking
API_BASE — base URL for the City Metro API (https://api.trip-planner.citymetro.xyz)
AUTH_ORIGIN — Authentik authentication origin (https://auth.citymetro.xyz)
